name: TransIP VPS

evidence.vps: 03: rented VPS with root access; TransIP maintains the hardware and the customer runs the OS and apps

line: Rent a Linux or Windows server and manage its apps yourself.

work.math: €5 a month before VAT, for 1 vCPU, 1 GB and 100 GB of NVMe storage. 100 GB of traffic is under fair use. Builds run on your VM or outside CI. The domain is extra, and performance is unverified.
A fixed €5 a month package (not 730 hourly units), before VAT, with 1 vCPU and 1 GB. 100 GB of traffic is under fair use, but request throughput is untested. The domain and CI are extra.
€10 for V2 + €5 a month for backups, before VAT. 2 GB RAM and a 100 GB disk. Backups run every 4 to 6 hours plus weekly, not seven daily restore points. Capacity is untested.
